what: Hovering menu text makes it split open from the center to both sides and vanish (1s), and .2s later the same text unfolds from the center to both sides and stands again (1s), like a curtain parting and closing. On release it closes in reverse in .6s. Curve cubic-bezier(.5,0,0,1). If the shadow text is a different color, the color changes as it parts.

options.--fx-back: Closing length when released (via style), default .6s
options.--fx-lag: Delay before the shadow unfolds (via style), default .2s
options.[data-fx-part=text] · [data-fx-part=shad: Two copies of the same text (children) — the shadow is aria-hidden. Shadow color is set by the using side’s css

from.where: /  shared.css .ks-split (header menu·dropdown·footer menu — on the black footer text is light gray, shadow is moon-white) — original .text_split
